auditor_source_scope: Private original checker retained outside the public tree; command omits its private directory. No production collision package imports or nonlinear evolution calls.

independent_representation.Lorentz: Positive Gaussian power expansion in (1-xi²), lifted to Bernstein degree128; independent symmetric birth/death angular generator diagonalization. This is distinct from producer Legendre projection.
independent_representation.Dougherty: Direct analytic single-Gaussian covariance, no mixture implementation import.
independent_representation.constrained: Homogeneous distribution unchanged; physicalF and nativef=2piF distinguished. Production kernel null check is retained evidence, not re-evaluated by this array audit.
independent_representation.mu_marginal: 128-point Gauss parallel integral on[-8,8] versus producer64/[-10,10]; positive-heat radial majorant provides stated omitted-tail bound.
independent_representation.Lorentz_entropy: 72radial/76pitch quadrature using independent Bernstein heat evaluation; scalar erf angle-average equilibrium integrated adaptively.

limits: Rate matching is a comparison convention, not physical calibration or equivalence of collision models.
Lorentz preserves radial populations and approaches a generally non-Maxwellian isotropic state.
No finite-time Landau curve is present; physical Landau contributes an instantaneous initial rate only.
Angular reconstructions and velocity quadratures are finite numerical approximations; this audit does not claim uniform relative accuracy in exponential tails.
GIF/MP4 frames are checked for count/time and hashes, not independently rendered pixels.
wall_s_scope: Historical source/output hashing, independent analytical and angular reconstruction, quadratures, and movie manifests; excludes imports/final receipt writing.
